meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把标题、数据或地图变成动态短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想做会动的标题、图表或地图,又不想学专业软件
copy.tagline_en: Turn headlines, data, or maps into short animated videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to bring titles, charts, or maps to life without learning pro software.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成短小的设计感运动图形动画，如动态文字、统计数字、图表、logo 或地图动效，通常不超过 10 秒（最多约 30 秒），无旁白，输出 MP4 或透明视频。
howto.when: 当你要求制作短小、设计主导、无旁白的运动图形（如动态文字、图表动画、logo 展示）时触发；时长超过约 10 秒或含旁白会转给其他技能。

say.text: 把这句话做成 8 秒的动态文字动画，不要旁白。
say.note: 触发 kinetic-type 类别，生成文字动效。

say.text: 用这组数据做一个柱状图增长动画。
say.note: 触发图表动画类别，输出动画视频。

say.text: 给我的 logo 做个 5 秒的片头，要透明背景。
say.note: 触发 logo 展示，可用透明叠加格式。

howto.what_en: Claude produces short design-led motion graphics (e.g. kinetic type, stat count-ups, chart animations, logo stings, map moves) under 10s, no narration, rendered as MP4 or transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a short, design-led, unnarrated motion graphic such as a text animation, chart animation, or logo sting. Longer or narrated requests are routed to /general-video instead.

say_en.text: Animate this sentence as 8s kinetic type, no narration.
say_en.note: Triggers kinetic-type and generates an MP4.

say_en.text: Create a bar chart growth animation from this data.
Make a 5-second logo sting with transparent background.
say_en.note: Triggers logo-reveal; may render as WebM overlay.
